findings.text: The docstring of _scheduler_state_argv (reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:196-200) and of _scheduler_query_argv (:74-77) still state that a scheduler question that cannot be asked 'falls through to the pid probe'. Since :387, a placed record whose scheduler cannot be queried returns LIVENESS_PLACED with alive None and never reaches the pid probe, so two docstrings in the module whose contract this commit set out to align now state the behaviour it removed. The added <li> in docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-worker/name-the-worker-a-launch-refusal-found.html claims 'the next reader finds one contract rather than three', which these two sites contradict.
